title: Balanced-Precision Delta (BPD)
originality_status: not admitted: classical balanced realization plus STEPQuant/DAMP and adjacent transform-coding/state-quantization work substantially cover the core function; narrow future-Gramian residual is insufficient
formal_object: For F_t=(I-beta_t k_t k_t^T)D_t and S_t=F_t S_(t-1)+beta_t k_t v_t^T, define frozen-future transport P_(t,h)=F_(t+h)...F_(t+1) and output-error metric O_t=sum_h omega_h P^T q_(t+h)q_(t+h)^T P. Let z_t be explicitly declared prefix-only calibration features and let C_t=C_theta(z_t) be a causally predicted positive-definite row-excitation metric; a stopped prefix EMA is an alternative estimator but E[S_t S_t^T/m | H_t] collapses to S_t S_t^T/m whenever the causal sigma-field H_t contains the exact state, so it is not advertised as a nontrivial conditional population covariance. Under B>=d b_min and sum_i b_i=B, minimize the local expected future-output disturbance from one coordinate-quantization injection at t. The deployed recurrence injects error repeatedly; no whole-trajectory risk follows without cross-injection assumptions. This is a finite-precision claim, not an unconditional state-capacity claim.

operations.input: Delta state, key/query and an invertible state-coordinate map T
operations.condition: Transform state, transition, key injection and query together
operations.output: An exactly equivalent real-arithmetic recurrence Z_t=T_t^-1 F_t T_(t-1) Z_(t-1)+beta_t T_t^-1 k_t v_t^T and readout (T_t^T q_t)^T Z_t

operations.condition: C_t is positive definite on the retained support
operations.output: Whitened coordinates with identity excitation covariance

operations.input: Frozen-future output quadratic O_t and excitation C_t
operations.condition: Future features are fixed; for a nonlinear network use the actual Jacobian instead
operations.output: Eigen-directions of C_t^(1/2) O_t C_t^(1/2) rank equal-scale coordinate noise by output consequence

operations.input: Risk sum_i lambda_i 2^(-2b_i), lower bit floor and total budget
operations.condition: Continuous bit relaxation is convex; discrete bits need an integer allocator
operations.output: Water-filling b_i=max{b_min, 0.5 log2(lambda_i/c)} with c fixed by the budget

operations.condition: All numerical effects are charged separately
operations.output: Granular quantization, overload/clipping, metric estimation and coordinate-refresh errors are distinct terms

operations.condition: Same total bit budget and calibration model
operations.output: Exact gain example and exact failure under metric drift

derivation_steps.statement: Let M=C^(1/2) O C^(1/2)=U Lambda U^T and choose T=C^(1/2)U, Z=T^-1 S.
derivation_steps.justification: Direct multiplication gives T^-1 C T^-T=I and T^T O T=Lambda.

derivation_steps.statement: If T changes with time, use Z_t=T_t^-1 F_t T_(t-1)Z_(t-1)+beta_t T_t^-1 k_t v_t^T and read with T_t^T q_t.
derivation_steps.justification: Substituting S_(t-1)=T_(t-1)Z_(t-1) and S_t=T_t Z_t preserves the ordered Delta recurrence.

derivation_steps.statement: With identity quantization, induction yields S_t=T_t Z_t at every step, so outputs equal ordinary Delta exactly.
derivation_steps.justification: The transformed transition and injection are an algebraic change of coordinates, not a changed model.

derivation_steps.statement: Under equal calibrated row ranges, no overload and independent subtractive dither, Var Xi_(ij)=nu 2^(-2b_i).
derivation_steps.justification: This is the declared input-independent granular-noise model; deterministic or nonsubtractive rounding is not silently equated with it.

derivation_steps.statement: For DeltaS=T Xi, E R_t(DeltaS)=m nu sum_i lambda_i 2^(-2b_i).
derivation_steps.justification: Use tr(Xi^T T^T O T Xi), diagonal Lambda and independent zero-mean row noise.

derivation_steps.statement: For B>=d b_min, positive lambda_i and a fixed active set, KKT gives b_i*=max{b_min,0.5 log2(lambda_i/c)} and equal active marginal risks lambda_i2^(-2b_i)=c; zero-lambda rows stay at the floor. Integer deployment requires a separate discrete allocator.
derivation_steps.justification: The continuous objective is separable convex and the equality multiplier is shared; complementary slackness handles the floor, but continuous water-filling alone does not certify an integer optimum.

derivation_steps.statement: For C=I, O=diag(16,1), B=8 and b_min<=3, the continuous optimum (also integer-feasible here) is (5,3), risk 8/256 versus uniform (4,4) risk 17/256.
derivation_steps.justification: The active KKT equation requires b1-b2=2 and direct substitution gives the two risks.

derivation_steps.statement: If the deployed metric swaps to diag(1,16), the stale (5,3) allocation has risk 1/1024+16/64, exceeding uniform 17/256.
derivation_steps.justification: This is an admissible causal-metric prediction failure and prevents an unconditional benefit claim.

assumptions: A real finite-bit, step-size or noise model is specified; finite-dimensional real state is not asserted to have finite information unconditionally.
C is positive definite on the modeled support; a ridge changes the problem and must be disclosed.
O uses identical frozen future features/inputs; nonlinear deployment needs Jacobian transport and has no theorem here.
The water-filling risk uses equal calibrated row ranges, no overload and independent zero-mean subtractive-dither error; clipping and deterministic or nonsubtractive rounding need separate terms.
Future q and F may define stopped training labels only. Deployment O-hat is a function of observed prefix features and cannot access a future token, label or answer.
No CE, accuracy, semantic retention or global error certificate follows from minimizing this local quadratic output disturbance.
Coordinate refresh, mixed-bit packing, scale and dither metadata, transform arithmetic and kernel arithmetic can dominate the nominal saving and are charged.
A time-varying eigenspace is aligned across refreshes or its discontinuity and finite-precision basis-change error are charged; T conditioning is monitored separately.
The proved risk concerns one error injection. Accumulated recurrent quantization, clipping, basis estimation and cross terms remain outside the theorem.
method_expression: From retained (T_(t-1),Z_(t-1)), form the pre-current-quantization candidate through the ordered transformed recurrence; because earlier steps were quantized, it is not called the unquantized ordinary-Delta trajectory. Prefix-only predictors C_theta(z_t)=L_C L_C^T+epsilon I and O_theta(z_t)=L_O L_O^T, with declared causal z_t, supply PSD metrics before current quantization. For a fixed full-precision reference trajectory, use stopped X_t=S_t^ref(S_t^ref)^T/m and Y_t=sum_h omega_h P_(t,h)^T q_(t+h)q_(t+h)^T P_(t,h), sampled from training prefixes, with auxiliary losses lambda_C E||C_theta(z_t)-stopgrad(X_t)||_F^2 and lambda_O E||O_theta(z_t)-stopgrad(Y_t)||_F^2; their gradients update the metric predictors only unless an encoder path is explicitly declared. A precisely defined stopped causal EMA from available reconstructed candidates may replace X supervision, but is a different estimator. Base model training remains ordinary CE. At a declared refresh cadence, eigenspaces are aligned to the preceding basis, form T=C^(1/2)U, allocate continuous bits by water-filling then use a declared integer allocator, and store Z_t=Q_b(T_t^-1 F_t T_(t-1)Z_(t-1)+beta_t T_t^-1 k_t v_t^T); output is (T_t^T q_t)^T Z_t. CE gradients do not pass through post-training quantization; a QAT STE/eigendecomposition gradient is an additional surrogate, not part of the proved method.
distinguishing_prediction: At matched total state bits, scale metadata and reads, benefit should concentrate at low precision, long propagation and anisotropic spectrum of C^(1/2)OC^(1/2), and track sum_i lambda_i2^(-2b_i). It should vanish in FP32/high precision or when O is proportional to C^-1. A persistent high-precision gain would refute the proposed finite-precision mechanism.
falsifier: The method is falsified as a useful Delta mechanism if the predicted quadratic disturbance is unrelated to actual output disturbance; matched uniform/per-channel quantization or a static rotation is no worse in the anisotropic regime; causal O-hat drift systematically makes risk worse than uniform allocation; or coordinate refresh, mixed-bit packing and kernel cost remove the memory/throughput benefit.
closest_alternative: The decisive closest work is STEPQuant v1 for GDN/KDA Delta recurrent state: ordered error propagation, readout/key-row impact, lifetime weighting and budgeted mixed precision. DAMP independently covers quantization energy, decay persistence and precision selection. Classical input-normal/output-diagonal realization already supplies the C/O coordinate idea; MambaQuant, SmoothQuant and LeapQuant cover rotation/scaling/compensation neighbors. The strongest simple baseline remains ordinary Delta with identical stored bits, per-channel scaling and stochastic rounding, then a fixed rotation or SmoothQuant-like rescaling.
decisive_comparison: The completed primary-source audit found major functional collision. The literal residual—full finite-horizon transported-query Gramian, dense generalized eigenbasis and causal O predictor—does not justify scientific admission because it composes known control coordinates, rate-distortion allocation and already implemented Delta-state sensitivity accounting while retaining O(d^3), drift and recurrent cross-injection gaps. No code or experiment is authorized for this rejected candidate.
complexity_and_information_access: Dense C/O/T requires O(d^2 m) state statistics/transforms and O(d^3) factorization, destroying the desired low-rank advantage. A plausible conditional form refreshes infrequently or uses block size g: about O(g d m) transform work per token, O(d g^2) per refresh and O(d g) statistics, plus predictor/optimizer, basis-alignment, scale, dither-seed and transform metadata. The payload budget is m sum_i b_i bits, while sum_i b_i=B is a per-value-column accounting convention; equal-memory comparison must charge all metadata. Training O targets use future queries and ordered products only as stopped labels; inference is prefix-only. Arbitrary mixed-bit kernel availability on RTX2080Ti is unknown and no feasibility is claimed.
independent_review: conditional mathematics review plus independent closest-work/exact-byte disposition review completed; reviewers and byte bindings are recorded in the review packet
measurement_status: Not admitted, so no experiment is dispatched. Existing bAbI/LAMBADA/RULER/BABILong scores do not directly identify state-quantization disturbance; no new benchmark or metric is created.
